ch.ch_vance.name: Professor Ottoline Vance
ch.ch_vance.bio1: Field researcher turned head of Lantern Hollow Field Station. Studies how a Trainer and a Pokémon reshape each other.
ch.ch_vance.bio2: Clips a dictaphone to her collar and loses her thread mid-sentence. Her Smeargle, Marginalia, sketches everything.
ch.ch_vance.bio3: Left the Halvard Institute twenty years ago after Dr. Lysandra Quill crossed an ethical line. She kept the data and the guilt.
ch.ch_pell_orrin.name: Pell Orrin
ch.ch_pell_orrin.bio1: A Scout who served beside you. Jokes to hide how worried he was.
ch.ch_pell_orrin.bio2: Looked for you for weeks after you left. Still carries your spare whistle.
ch.ch_pell_orrin.bio3: Can become an ally, a rival-adjacent shadow, or an enemy, depending on what you say first.
ch.ch_cass_verrin.name: Cass Verrin
ch.ch_cass_verrin.bio1: Marauder Persuasion executive. Warm, remembers you fondly and believes in the cause sincerely.
ch.ch_cass_verrin.bio2: Never threatens. Offers a way back and means it.
ch.ch_cass_verrin.bio3: Her kindness is the real danger: she is not lying.
ch.ch_halima_fenn.name: Inspector Halima Fenn
ch.ch_halima_fenn.bio1: League Integrity Bureau inspector. Methodical and fair.
ch.ch_halima_fenn.bio2: Starts at Suspicion. Her questions are never hostile.
ch.ch_halima_fenn.bio3: Can become the strongest institutional ally you have.
ch.ch_marek_voss.name: Marek Voss
ch.ch_marek_voss.bio1: Head of Marauder Acquisition. The one executive who never forgave the departure.
ch.ch_marek_voss.bio2: Sends bounty teams after those who leave.
ch.ch_tally.name: Tally
ch.ch_tally.bio1: A Sandile with a clipped scale. The Pokémon you could not save.
ch.ch_tally.bio2: Will not come near. Remembers the whistle.
ch.ch_nell_hallam.name: Nell Hallam
ch.ch_nell_hallam.bio1: Her older sibling is trapped in a Marauder division. She left the plea in the dead drop.
ch.ch_nell_hallam.bio2: Writes in the old field-network code, badly.
ev_intro_ex_criminal.vance.v1: Vance does not ask what you did. She asks what you carry.
ev_intro_ex_criminal.vance.v2: She glances at the pale patch on your coat and says nothing about it.
ev_intro_ex_criminal.vance.v3: "People leave places. The interesting question is what they leave with."
ev_intro_ex_criminal.b1: I will not ask what you did. I will ask what you carry.
ev_intro_ex_criminal.b2: Marginalia sketches a torn patch on a coat. Vance does not look at it.
ev_old_uniform.pell.v2: "Do you know how many of us looked for you?"
ev_old_uniform.pell.v3: "Still got your whistle. Never could bring myself to toss it."
ev_old_uniform.b1: A man on the forest road stops mid-step. He knows the shape of your coat.
ev_old_uniform.b2: Do you know how many of us looked for you?
ev_old_uniform.c.deny: Pretend you do not know him
ev_old_uniform.c.ask_others: Ask what happened to the others
ev_old_uniform.c.ask_help: Ask him to help against the Marauders
ev_unfinished_business.cass.v1: "No weapons. Sit. Let me buy you a coffee."
ev_unfinished_business.cass.v2: "I never stopped thinking of you as one of ours."
ev_unfinished_business.cass.v3: "You told me once the cause was worth it. Was that a lie?"
ev_unfinished_business.b1: A cafe. One table. Cass Verrin is alone and unarmed.
ev_unfinished_business.b2: Three small jobs. Then you are home.
ev_tally_1.tally.v1: A Sandile glimpsed at the edge of the frame. Gone when you look straight at it.
ev_tally_1.tally.v2: It has been following you for two Nodes.
ev_tally_1.tally.v3: A clipped scale catches the light.
ev_tally_1.b1: A Sandile glimpsed at the edge of the frame. Gone when you look straight at it.
ev_tally_1.b2: It has been following you for two Nodes.
ev_tally_2.tally.v1: It will not come near. You leave food and walk away.
ev_tally_2.tally.v2: It eats once you are out of sight.
ev_tally_2.b1: It will not come near. You leave food and walk away.
ev_tally_2.b2: It eats once you are out of sight.
ev_tally_3.tally.v1: A Marauder tracker is working the same road. You hide Tally behind your coat.
ev_tally_3.tally.v2: The tracker stops, sniffs the air, moves on.
ev_tally_3.tally.v3: Tally does not move until you say so.
ev_tally_3.b1: A Marauder tracker is working the same road. You hide Tally behind your coat.
ev_tally_3.b2: The tracker stops, sniffs the air, moves on.
ev_tally_4.tally.v1: Your old whistle slips out. Tally bolts.
ev_tally_4.tally.v2: You never whistle that way again. You did not mean to.
ev_tally_4.tally.v3: The grass is still moving where it went.
ev_tally_4.b1: Your old whistle slips out. Tally bolts.
ev_tally_4.b2: You never whistle that way again. You did not mean to.
ev_tally_5.tally.v1: A cave. Tally is inside, watching.
ev_tally_5.tally.v2: Follow it in, or let it go.
ev_tally_5.tally.v3: Either way, it was never yours to keep.
ev_tally_5.b1: A cave. Tally is inside, watching.
ev_tally_5.b2: Follow it in, or let it go.
ev_ledger_room.scout.v1: Guard patrols loop every ninety seconds. You know because you wrote the loop.
ev_ledger_room.scout.v2: The labs are labelled the way you used to label them.
ev_ledger_room.scout.v3: The holding pens go quiet when you walk in. You always could do that.
ev_ledger_room.b1: A hidden facility. You recognize the layout before you recognize the door.
ev_ledger_room.c.negotiate: Talk the squad down with rank phrases
ev_parole.fenn.v1: "I have a few questions. You may decline any of them."
ev_parole.fenn.v2: "I am not here to arrest you. I am here to understand you."
ev_parole.fenn.v3: "You told me the truth last time. That counts."
ev_parole.b1: Walk with me. I keep a list of people who left, and you are on it.
ev_dead_drop.nell.v1: A note in a hollow tree, written in the old field-network code. Badly.
ev_dead_drop.nell.v2: "If you can read this, you were one of them. Please be one of them."
ev_dead_drop.nell.v3: "They took my sibling to a division I cannot name."
ev_dead_drop.b1: A hollow tree the field network used. Someone has left a plea in it.
ev_rank_and_file.grunt.v2: "Quartermaster's clerk? Handler? Say something only one of us would know."
ev_rank_and_file.grunt.v3: "I never saw you. You never saw me."
ev_rank_and_file.b1: A squad blocks the road. One of them recognizes how you stand.
ev_departure_truth.vance.v1: "Ah, hold that thought." She records a note. "Is this what happened?"
ev_departure_truth.vance.v2: "I wrote to Quill for a year. I thought it was a research society."
ev_departure_truth.vance.v3: "I have been watching for former members ever since. I am sorry it took me this long to say so."
ev_departure_truth.b1: A flashback, built from the one thing you have never said aloud.
ev_departure_truth.b2: The scene ends. A single question hangs in the air.
ev_departure_truth.c.cleaned: No. I left. That is all.
ev_pell_defection_1.pell.v1: "I can get you a list. Names, not codes."
ev_pell_defection_1.pell.v2: Pell hands over a folded page. His hands are not steady.
ev_pell_defection_1.b1: "I can get you a list. Names, not codes."
ev_pell_defection_1.b2: Pell hands over a folded page. His hands are not steady.
ev_pell_defection_2.pell.v1: "If this goes bad, I was never here."
ev_pell_defection_2.pell.v2: The list is real. Three names are crossed out in red.
ev_pell_defection_2.b1: "If this goes bad, I was never here."
ev_pell_defection_2.b2: The list is real. Three names are crossed out in red.
ev_nell_rescue_1.nell.v1: "There is a back door. It sticks."
ev_nell_rescue_1.nell.v2: The back door sticks. You know exactly how to lift it.
ev_nell_rescue_1.b1: "There is a back door. It sticks."
ev_nell_rescue_1.b2: The back door sticks. You know exactly how to lift it.
ev_nell_rescue_2.nell.v1: "Is it really you? You look like the poster."
ev_nell_rescue_2.nell.v2: A sibling steps out of the dark, thin and alive.
ev_nell_rescue_2.b1: "Is it really you? You look like the poster."
ev_nell_rescue_2.b2: A sibling steps out of the dark, thin and alive.
ev_echo_ex_crim_01.speaker.v1: A wanted-style poster has your old rank on it. Someone has drawn a mustache.
ev_echo_ex_crim_01.speaker.v2: A stranger crosses the street to avoid you, then looks back.
ev_echo_ex_crim_01.speaker.v3: A kid asks if you are the coat from the posters. You say no.
ev_echo_ex_crim_01.b1: A wanted-style poster has your old rank on it. Someone has drawn a mustache.
ev_echo_ex_crim_02.speaker.v1: A radio call in a diner: "...and to anyone who left, the door is always open."
ev_echo_ex_crim_02.speaker.v2: The broadcast is Cass's voice. You turn it down. You do not turn it off.
ev_echo_ex_crim_02.speaker.v3: You finish your meal and leave a larger tip than needed.
ev_echo_ex_crim_02.b1: A radio call in a diner: "...and to anyone who left, the door is always open."
ev_echo_ex_crim_03.speaker.v1: A Bureau notice about missing paperwork. Your name is not on it. Yet.
ev_echo_ex_crim_03.speaker.v2: A mailbox holds a sealed envelope with no stamp. You do not open it.
ev_echo_ex_crim_03.speaker.v3: A clerk says: "Inspector Fenn asked me to tell you she is not in a hurry."
ev_echo_ex_crim_03.b1: A Bureau notice about missing paperwork. Your name is not on it. Yet.
ev_end_redeemed.narrator.v1: You testify. Inspector Fenn walks you out. Tally is at your side.
ev_end_redeemed.narrator.v2: The patch stays off. The coat stays on.
ev_end_redeemed.narrator.v3: The patch stays off. The coat stays on.
ev_end_redeemed.b1: You testify. Inspector Fenn walks you out. Tally is at your side.
ev_end_redeemed.b2: The patch stays off. The coat stays on.
ev_end_reconciled.narrator.v1: Cass or Pell walks away from the Marauders, because of you.
ev_end_reconciled.narrator.v2: You do not ask them to forgive you.
ev_end_reconciled.narrator.v3: You do not ask them to forgive you.
ev_end_reconciled.b1: Cass or Pell walks away from the Marauders, because of you.
ev_end_reconciled.b2: You do not ask them to forgive you.
ev_end_relapse.narrator.v1: In the epilogue you put the patch back on. The Chronicle marks it: "What might have been".
ev_end_relapse.narrator.v2: No one is surprised, least of all you.
ev_end_relapse.narrator.v3: No one is surprised, least of all you.
ev_end_relapse.b1: In the epilogue you put the patch back on. The Chronicle marks it: "What might have been".
ev_end_relapse.b2: No one is surprised, least of all you.
ev_end_ghost.narrator.v1: You leave without a name. The credits show an empty coat.
ev_end_ghost.b1: You leave without a name. The credits show an empty coat.
lore.lore_marauder_divisions.name: The Marauder divisions
lore.lore_marauder_divisions.i1: Acquisition, Persuasion, Field and Research. Each thinks the others are the problem.
lore.lore_marauder_divisions.i2: A cause with four mouths and one stomach.
lore.lore_marauder_divisions.body: Acquisition, Persuasion, Field and Research. Each thinks the others are the problem.
lore.lore_tally.name: Tally the Sandile
lore.lore_tally.i1: A Sandile with a clipped scale. It remembers a whistle.
lore.lore_tally.body: A Sandile with a clipped scale. It remembers a whistle.
lore.lore_ex_criminal_notoriety.name: What recognition costs
lore.lore_ex_criminal_notoriety.i1: At three, doors close. At five, a bounty team comes calling.
lore.lore_ex_criminal_notoriety.body: At three, doors close. At five, a bounty team comes calling.
bs.ex_criminal.name: Ex-Criminal
ch.ch_gideon_hartwell.name: Gideon Hartwell
ch.ch_gideon_hartwell.bio1: Former Champion of the Orrery League, retired seven years ago. Talented, quiet, hard to impress.
ch.ch_gideon_hartwell.bio2: Loving but unable to say it. His calls are two sentences long.
ch.ch_gideon_hartwell.bio3: Forfeited a tournament final and has never said why.
ch.ch_bedrock.name: Bedrock
ch.ch_bedrock.bio1: Gideon's Tyranitar from his Championship years. Scarred, watchful, and unwilling to take your orders.
ch.ch_bedrock.bio2: Recognizes you. Waits to see if you deserve to be recognized.
ch.ch_odette_marr.name: Odette Marr
ch.ch_odette_marr.bio1: A seasoned Gym Leader who refuses to treat you as an equal.
ch.ch_odette_marr.bio3: She was an heir once herself.
ch.ch_silas_crane.name: Silas Crane
ch.ch_silas_crane.bio1: Lost to Gideon fifteen years ago and has trained for the rematch ever since.
ch.ch_silas_crane.bio2: Wants to beat the child instead.
ch.ch_tavi_marsh.name: Tavi Marsh
ch.ch_tavi_marsh.bio1: Sports journalist. Asks the questions everyone wants answered.
ch.ch_tavi_marsh.bio2: Fair, relentless, and secretly rooting for you.
ch.ch_the_examiner.name: The Examiner
ch.ch_the_examiner.bio1: A League official. Appears at Gyms and Elite events with a clipboard and an offer.
ev_intro_champion_heir.vance.v1: Vance sets down a framed photograph of the Orrery League final. "I took this."
ev_intro_champion_heir.vance.v2: She does not say whose crest is on your jacket. She does not need to.
ev_intro_champion_heir.vance.v3: "You pick at it when you think no one is looking."
ev_intro_champion_heir.b2: Your phone buzzes. Gideon Hartwell: "Heard you started. Eat properly." That is his whole speech.
ev_intro_champion_heir.c.know_him: "Then you know him better than I do."
ev_name_to_live_up_to.marr.v1: "I will fight the next Hartwell when one shows up."
ev_name_to_live_up_to.marr.v2: "You are wearing the crest. I asked for a Trainer."
ev_name_to_live_up_to.marr.v3: "Fine. Ask me why. Everyone eventually does."
ev_name_to_live_up_to.b1: I do not schedule battles for last names.
ev_name_to_live_up_to.c.trial: Prove yourself in a borrowed-team double battle
ev_bedrock_1.bedrock.v1: Bedrock stands in the road, scarred, watching. It knows you. It will not take a command.
ev_bedrock_1.bedrock.v2: The old Tyranitar turns its head, slowly, to look at the crest.
ev_bedrock_1.bedrock.v3: You stop reaching for the ball. It notices.
ev_bedrock_1.b1: Bedrock stands in the road, scarred, watching. It knows you. It will not take a command.
ev_bedrock_1.b2: The old Tyranitar turns its head, slowly, to look at the crest.
ev_bedrock_2.bedrock.v1: You share a meal. It eats last.
ev_bedrock_2.bedrock.v2: It takes the food but not your eyes.
ev_bedrock_2.bedrock.v3: It lies down at the edge of the fire, facing out.
ev_bedrock_2.b1: You share a meal. It eats last.
ev_bedrock_2.b2: It takes the food but not your eyes.
ev_bedrock_3.bedrock.v1: A rockfall. You both move at once.
ev_bedrock_3.bedrock.v2: Stone comes down between you. It does not leave.
ev_bedrock_3.bedrock.v3: Dust settles. Neither of you says anything.
ev_bedrock_3.b1: A rockfall. You both move at once.
ev_bedrock_3.b2: Stone comes down between you. It does not leave.
ev_bedrock_4.bedrock.v2: It does not hold back. Neither do you.
ev_bedrock_4.bedrock.v3: It lowers its head. The test is over.
ev_bedrock_4.b2: It does not hold back. Neither do you.
ev_unfinished_final.gideon.v1: "That final. I forfeited. That is all there is."
ev_unfinished_final.gideon.v2: "It was my choice. I would like it to stay mine."
ev_unfinished_final.gideon.v3: "You can ask me. I might even answer."
ev_unfinished_final.b1: A veteran tells you the one thing nobody in the family will: Gideon forfeited a final and never said why.
ev_unfinished_final.c.seek: Find the opponent's student and play the match
ev_fathers_shadow.crane.v1: "Fifteen years I have waited for a Hartwell."
ev_fathers_shadow.crane.v2: "Your father beat me with this one Pokémon. Watch it closely."
ev_fathers_shadow.b1: I lost to your father. I am not going to lose to you.
ev_hartwell_call_1.gideon.v2: Two sentences. You read them three times.
ev_hartwell_call_1.gideon.v3: You reply. It takes you ten minutes to write one line.
ev_hartwell_call_1.b2: Two sentences. You read them three times.
ev_hartwell_call_2.gideon.v2: You can hear him not saying something.
ev_hartwell_call_2.gideon.v3: The line goes quiet. Neither of you hangs up.
ev_hartwell_call_2.b2: You can hear him not saying something.
ev_hartwell_call_3.gideon.v1: The house is quiet. I sleep fine.
ev_hartwell_call_3.gideon.v2: He says it too fast to be true.
ev_hartwell_call_3.gideon.v3: You tell him about the Pokémon you picked. He laughs, once.
ev_hartwell_call_3.b1: The house is quiet. I sleep fine.
ev_hartwell_call_3.b2: He says it too fast to be true.
ev_hartwell_call_4.gideon.v2: He says what he has been saving. It is not what you expected.
ev_hartwell_call_4.gideon.v3: Whatever he says, you hear it.
ev_hartwell_call_4.b2: He says what he has been saving. It is not what you expected.
ev_press_pit.tavi.v1: "Same question everyone has: are you his kid, or are you you?"
ev_press_pit.tavi.v2: "Be honest. I will quote you either way."
ev_press_pit.tavi.v3: "That was a good answer. I will make it the headline."
ev_press_pit.b1: Congratulations on the win. Are you going to say it, or do I?
ev_trophy_room.gideon.v1: The shelf is empty. He has not said why.
ev_trophy_room.gideon.v2: "I never filled it. I kept thinking I would."
ev_trophy_room.gideon.v3: "Sit. I will make something. I am not good at this."
ev_trophy_room.housekeeper.v1: "He stands here some evenings. Pretending he does not."
ev_trophy_room.housekeeper.v3: "Take whatever you need. He would want you to."
ev_trophy_room.b1: The Hartwell house. Every shelf is full except one.
ev_the_sponsor.examiner.v1: "The League would like to help you. For the right image."
ev_the_sponsor.examiner.v2: "Wear the crest where people can see it. That is all."
ev_the_sponsor.examiner.v3: "Think about what refusing says about you."
ev_the_sponsor.b1: A sponsorship. Money, an audience, a seat at the table. One small thing in return.
ev_echo_champion_heir_01.speaker.v1: A fan asks for an autograph and calls you "the Heir" before you say your name.
ev_echo_champion_heir_01.speaker.v2: A magazine rack shows a photo of Gideon at your age. Someone has drawn on the crest.
ev_echo_champion_heir_01.speaker.v3: A stranger tells you your father would be proud. You do not know whether to thank them.
ev_echo_champion_heir_01.b1: A fan asks for an autograph and calls you "the Heir" before you say your name.
ev_echo_champion_heir_02.speaker.v1: A voicemail: "Heard you started. Eat properly." You play it again.
ev_echo_champion_heir_02.speaker.v2: A parcel from home. No note. A scarf. It is exactly your size.
ev_echo_champion_heir_02.speaker.v3: You pass a billboard of the old final. Gideon is looking at something outside the frame.
ev_echo_champion_heir_02.b1: A voicemail: "Heard you started. Eat properly." You play it again.
ev_echo_champion_heir_03.speaker.v1: A veteran stops you in a corridor: "You are a Hartwell? Say it aloud and I will battle you."
ev_echo_champion_heir_03.speaker.v2: An old Guard Trainer salutes the crest. You are not sure it is for you.
ev_echo_champion_heir_03.speaker.v3: Someone slips a note under your door: "Crane is training. Be ready."
ev_echo_champion_heir_03.b1: A veteran stops you in a corridor: "You are a Hartwell? Say it aloud and I will battle you."
ev_end_heir.narrator.v1: You take the title in Gideon's old arena. He is silent a long moment, then says the first full sentence he has said all run.
ev_end_heir.narrator.v2: It is not "I am proud." It is better.
ev_end_heir.narrator.v3: It is not "I am proud." It is better.
ev_end_heir.b1: You take the title in Gideon's old arena. He is silent a long moment, then says the first full sentence he has said all run.
ev_end_heir.b2: It is not "I am proud." It is better.
ev_end_refusal.narrator.v1: You step off the path in public. Gideon watches the news alone and nods.
ev_end_refusal.narrator.v2: You never find out he saved the clip.
ev_end_refusal.narrator.v3: You never find out he saved the clip.
ev_end_refusal.b1: You step off the path in public. Gideon watches the news alone and nods.
ev_end_refusal.b2: You never find out he saved the clip.
ev_end_third_way.narrator.v1: Father and child battle together in an exhibition, equal partners.
ev_end_third_way.narrator.v2: Bedrock stands between you, facing neither.
ev_end_third_way.narrator.v3: Bedrock stands between you, facing neither.
ev_end_third_way.b1: Father and child battle together in an exhibition, equal partners.
ev_end_third_way.b2: Bedrock stands between you, facing neither.
ev_end_shadow.narrator.v1: You win to be compared, and lose the one that mattered. Crane's apology is the only comfort.
ev_end_shadow.narrator.v2: You are still wearing the crest. You wonder who put it on.
ev_end_shadow.narrator.v3: You are still wearing the crest. You wonder who put it on.
ev_end_shadow.b1: You win to be compared, and lose the one that mattered. Crane's apology is the only comfort.
ev_end_shadow.b2: You are still wearing the crest. You wonder who put it on.
ev_end_own_name.narrator.v1: A different title, a different style. Gideon is in the audience.
ev_end_own_name.narrator.v2: The announcer says your name. Just your name.
ev_end_own_name.narrator.v3: The announcer says your name. Just your name.
ev_end_own_name.b1: A different title, a different style. Gideon is in the audience.
ev_end_own_name.b2: The announcer says your name. Just your name.
lore.lore_marr_heir.name: Odette Marr, once an heir
lore.lore_marr_heir.i1: She was handed a gym at nineteen and spent a decade proving she deserved it.
lore.lore_marr_heir.body: She was handed a gym at nineteen and spent a decade proving she deserved it.
lore.lore_bedrock.name: Bedrock, the champion's Tyranitar
lore.lore_bedrock.i1: A Tyranitar that carried a champion for seven years and never once heard thanks.
lore.lore_bedrock.i2: It waits where the road bends, as if for a call that never came.
lore.lore_bedrock.body: A Tyranitar that carried a champion for seven years and never once heard thanks.
lore.lore_hartwell_final.name: The unfinished final
lore.lore_hartwell_final.i1: Gideon forfeited a final against an unnamed opponent.
lore.lore_hartwell_final.i2: He forfeited because he could not bear to win it.
lore.lore_hartwell_final.body: Gideon forfeited a final against an unnamed opponent.
bs.champion_heir.name: Champion to Be
ch.ch_hollis_wren.name: Hollis Wren
ch.ch_hollis_wren.bio1: Retired forest ranger. Taught you to read tracks. Gruff, funny and very observant.
ch.ch_hollis_wren.bio2: Never says a thing is wrong. Asks what you noticed instead.
ch.ch_hollis_wren.bio3: Recognizes a drained habitat the moment he sees one, and has been waiting for someone to ask.
ch.ch_odessa_fennimore.name: Odessa Fennimore
ch.ch_odessa_fennimore.bio1: Neighbor from childhood, now a berry farmer.
ch.ch_odessa_fennimore.bio2: Remembers the summer you brought home an injured Weedle, and remembers it differently than you do.
ch.ch_odessa_fennimore.bio3: Says the Weedle saved you, not the other way round.
ch.ch_ilya_santangelo.name: Dr. Ilya Santangelo
ch.ch_ilya_santangelo.bio1: Researcher who wants to measure how wild Pokémon behave around you.
ch.ch_ilya_santangelo.bio2: His intentions are good and his methods are clinical.
ch.ch_ilya_santangelo.bio3: Can become a real ally if you set the terms.
ch.ch_elder_butterfree.name: The Elder Butterfree
ch.ch_elder_butterfree.bio1: The Caterpie you fed as a child. Once shy, now regal.
ch.ch_elder_butterfree.bio2: Settles on your shoulder as if it never left.
ch.ch_greenwall_manager.name: Greenwall Field Manager
ch.ch_greenwall_manager.bio1: Runs the surveying crew for Greenwall Holdings, a subsidiary of the Ironvein Combine. Follows orders.
ev_intro_viridian.vance.v1: Marginalia sketches a pond as you walk Vance through the map of your forest.
ev_intro_viridian.vance.v2: "A ranger's cabin. Good. You will know the sound of someone not wanting to be found."
ev_intro_viridian.vance.v3: "Do they talk to you, or do you just listen better than most?"
ev_intro_viridian.b1: Do you think they talk to you, or do you just listen better than most?
ev_intro_viridian.b2: She writes your answer in her notebook and underlines it twice.
ev_forest_remembers.butterfree.v1: A Butterfree descends from the canopy and settles on your shoulder.
ev_forest_remembers.butterfree.v2: It is the Caterpie you fed. It has grown regal where it was shy.
ev_forest_remembers.butterfree.v3: It waits. It has always waited.
ev_forest_remembers.b1: A path you know. The forest goes quiet around it.
ev_old_friend.odessa.v1: Odessa remembers the summer you brought home an injured Weedle.
ev_old_friend.odessa.v2: "It was the Weedle that saved you," she says, and means it.
ev_old_friend.odessa.v3: You do not remember it that way. Neither of you says so.
ev_old_friend.b1: Odessa remembers the summer you brought home an injured Weedle.
ev_old_friend.b2: "It was the Weedle that saved you," she says, and means it.
ev_old_friend.c.stay: Stay for tea and let it lie
ev_old_friend_2.odessa.v1: The childhood site. A vision rises: small hands, a hurt Weedle, a Beedrill that stayed.
ev_old_friend_2.odessa.v2: The Beedrill is still there. It remembers you.
ev_old_friend_2.odessa.v3: The two stories do not match. Both are true enough.
ev_old_friend_2.b1: The childhood site. A vision rises: small hands, a hurt Weedle, a Beedrill that stayed.
ev_old_friend_2.b2: The Beedrill is still there. It remembers you.
ev_migration_1.sighting.v1: Pokémon are leaving the forest in a line. Nothing hunts them. Nothing drives them.
ev_migration_1.sighting.v2: The line is perfectly quiet. It is the quiet that frightens you.
ev_migration_1.sighting.v3: You count them. You lose count.
ev_migration_1.b1: Pokémon are leaving the forest in a line. Nothing hunts them. Nothing drives them.
ev_migration_1.b2: The line is perfectly quiet. It is the quiet that frightens you.
ev_migration_2.hollis.v1: "Drained habitat," Hollis says. "I have seen it once. Never this fast."
ev_migration_2.hollis.v2: He points at the roots. They are dry to the depth of a hand.
ev_migration_2.hollis.v3: "Somebody is taking the water, or the shade, or both."
ev_migration_2.b1: "Drained habitat," Hollis says. "I have seen it once. Never this fast."
ev_migration_2.b2: He points at the roots. They are dry to the depth of a hand.
ev_migration_3.allies.v1: A Gym Leader and a ranger agree to help. One of them is a skeptic.
ev_migration_3.allies.v2: The skeptic says it is a natural cycle. The ranger says nothing at all.
ev_migration_3.allies.v3: Between them you find the shape of the problem.
ev_migration_3.b1: A Gym Leader and a ranger agree to help. One of them is a skeptic.
ev_migration_3.b2: The skeptic says it is a natural cycle. The ranger says nothing at all.
ev_migration_4.stakes.v1: Stakes and surveying equipment bear the Greenwall Holdings mark.
ev_migration_4.stakes.v2: The tags are new. The cuts in the bark are not.
ev_migration_4.stakes.v3: You photograph everything. Your hands are not steady.
ev_migration_4.b1: Stakes and surveying equipment bear the Greenwall Holdings mark.
ev_migration_4.b2: The tags are new. The cuts in the bark are not.
ev_migration_5.confront.v1: "I just follow the survey," the manager says. "I do not make the survey."
ev_migration_5.confront.v2: Behind him the crew has stopped working. They are listening.
ev_migration_5.confront.v3: Whatever you choose, the forest is watching.
ev_migration_5.b1: "I just follow the survey," the manager says. "I do not make the survey."
ev_migration_5.b2: Behind him the crew has stopped working. They are listening.
ev_childhood_map.odessa.v1: Your old drawn map is in a school desk. Three marks are circled.
ev_childhood_map.odessa.v2: A pond, a sinkhole, a ridge. You drew them as if they were countries.
ev_childhood_map.odessa.v3: "You always said the sinkhole was where the Nidoran lived."
ev_childhood_map.b1: A school desk. Inside, your old map.
ev_map_pond.place.v1: The pond is smaller than you remember. A Poliwag watches from the reeds.
ev_map_pond.place.v2: It spirals once, as if recognising a tune.
ev_map_pond.b1: The pond is smaller than you remember. A Poliwag watches from the reeds.
ev_map_pond.b2: It spirals once, as if recognising a tune.
ev_map_sinkhole.place.v1: Two Nidoran, one on each rim of the hollow. They keep their distance from each other and from you.
ev_map_sinkhole.place.v2: They approach together when you sit down.
ev_map_sinkhole.place.v3: You keep both names on the map.
ev_map_sinkhole.b1: Two Nidoran, one on each rim of the hollow. They keep their distance from each other and from you.
ev_map_sinkhole.b2: They approach together when you sit down.
ev_map_ridge.place.v1: The ridge has a lookout. The whole forest lies below, even and green.
ev_map_ridge.place.v2: Somewhere a Pidgey calls. The sound carries for miles.
ev_map_ridge.place.v3: You stay until the light changes.
ev_map_ridge.b1: The ridge has a lookout. The whole forest lies below, even and green.
ev_map_ridge.b2: Somewhere a Pidgey calls. The sound carries for miles.
ev_first_aid.hollis.v1: "Do not rush it. Hurt things can smell hurry."
ev_first_aid.hollis.v2: "What do you have on you? Start there."
ev_first_aid.hollis.v3: "That is how it is done. Slowly."
ev_first_aid.b1: A hurt wild Pokémon in the road, breathing in short, careful sips.
ev_first_aid.c.treat: Treat it with what you have
ev_first_aid.c.sit: Sit with it until it calms
ev_researchers_offer.santangelo.v1: "I would like to measure how wild Pokémon behave around you."
ev_researchers_offer.santangelo.v2: "It will be painless. For you, at least."
ev_researchers_offer.santangelo.v3: "Your terms. I would rather have an ally than a subject."
ev_researchers_offer.b1: I have been trying to find you for two years. Please, sit.
ev_the_hush.forest.v1: The forest goes silent. Pokémon stand at the edge of the clearing.
ev_the_hush.forest.v3: One of them looks at you and waits to be spoken to.
ev_the_hush.b1: The Hush. A wordless clearing. Every Pokémon is still.
ev_last_summer.vance.v1: A hilltop. You are ten. The first Pokémon that ever trusted you sits close.
ev_last_summer.vance.v2: Your Starter sits beside you and watches the child you were.
ev_last_summer.vance.v3: "I knew your grandparent," Vance says quietly. "They taught me to watch rather than command."
ev_last_summer.b1: Last day of summer. You are ten, and something is looking back.
ev_last_summer.c.wonder: Wonder whether it was more than that
ev_echo_viridian_01.speaker.v1: A faint trail in the grass that only you seem to see.
ev_echo_viridian_01.speaker.v2: A radio ranger reads out the day's sightings. You nod before he says the next one.
ev_echo_viridian_01.speaker.v3: A crow lands on the signpost and does not leave until you do.
ev_echo_viridian_01.b1: A faint trail in the grass that only you seem to see.
ev_echo_viridian_02.speaker.v1: A basket of berries left on a step. No note, but you know the knot.
ev_echo_viridian_02.speaker.v2: A postcard from Odessa: "Jam is ready. Come before the wasps do."
ev_echo_viridian_02.speaker.v3: A child asks if you can really talk to them. You say not talk, exactly.
ev_echo_viridian_02.b1: A basket of berries left on a step. No note, but you know the knot.
ev_echo_viridian_03.speaker.v1: A field notebook left on a bench: "Subject H. Calm behaviour at 2m."
ev_echo_viridian_03.speaker.v2: A researcher steps back as you walk by. Pokémon around you do not.
ev_echo_viridian_03.speaker.v3: A card in your pocket you do not remember taking: "When you are ready."
ev_echo_viridian_03.b1: A field notebook left on a bench: "Subject H. Calm behaviour at 2m."
ev_end_gardener.narrator.v1: The forest returns to normal. Hollis sets down his binoculars.
ev_end_gardener.narrator.v2: He does not say anything. He does not need to.
ev_end_gardener.narrator.v3: He does not say anything. He does not need to.
ev_end_gardener.b1: The forest returns to normal. Hollis sets down his binoculars.
ev_end_gardener.b2: He does not say anything. He does not need to.
ev_end_listener.narrator.v1: Vance writes "practice, patience, attention" in her notebook and underlines it.
ev_end_listener.narrator.v2: Marginalia sketches a pond. It is the right pond.
ev_end_listener.narrator.v3: Marginalia sketches a pond. It is the right pond.
ev_end_listener.b1: Vance writes "practice, patience, attention" in her notebook and underlines it.
ev_end_listener.b2: Marginalia sketches a pond. It is the right pond.
ev_end_echo.narrator.v1: The Hush plays again. The final shot is you looking up as every Pokémon looks back.
ev_end_echo.narrator.v2: Whatever it was, it was real enough.
ev_end_echo.narrator.v3: Whatever it was, it was real enough.
ev_end_echo.b1: The Hush plays again. The final shot is you looking up as every Pokémon looks back.
ev_end_echo.b2: Whatever it was, it was real enough.
ev_end_reckoning.narrator.v1: A habitat is lost. You carry the memory.
ev_end_reckoning.narrator.v2: The forest is quieter than it was. You listen anyway.
ev_end_reckoning.narrator.v3: The forest is quieter than it was. You listen anyway.
ev_end_reckoning.b1: A habitat is lost. You carry the memory.
ev_end_reckoning.b2: The forest is quieter than it was. You listen anyway.
lore.lore_weedle_two_readings.name: The Weedle, two ways
lore.lore_viridian_gift.name: Practised or resonant
lore.lore_viridian_gift.i1: A lifetime of attention, practised until it looks like magic.
lore.lore_viridian_gift.i2: Something older, that answers when you ask.
lore.lore_viridian_gift.body: A lifetime of attention, practised until it looks like magic.
lore.lore_the_hush.name: The Hush
lore.lore_the_hush.i1: A clearing where Pokémon go still. No one knows who it listens to.
lore.lore_the_hush.body: A clearing where Pokémon go still. No one knows who it listens to.
lore.lore_greenwall_holdings.name: Greenwall Holdings
lore.lore_greenwall_holdings.i1: A logging and land company, and a quiet subsidiary of the Ironvein Combine.
lore.lore_greenwall_holdings.body: A logging and land company, and a quiet subsidiary of the Ironvein Combine.
bs.viridian.name: Viridian Virtuoso
ch.ch_okoro.name: Dr. Wilhelmina Okoro
ch.ch_okoro.bio1: Lead researcher of Project Concordance. Warm, careful and quiet.
ch.ch_okoro.bio2: Insists the experiment was never meant to hurt anyone.
ch.ch_okoro.bio3: Who she really is depends on the Premise the run was dealt.
ch.ch_castellan.name: Warden Ruel Castellan
ch.ch_castellan.bio1: Head of Containment. Methodical, patient and not cruel.
ch.ch_castellan.bio2: Believes he is protecting people. Treats you as property only because he has to.
ch.ch_castellan.bio3: Will let you walk to the door, if you come willingly.
ch.ch_odile.name: Odile
ch.ch_odile.bio1: Subject Four. Cheerful, unstable and hungry for contact.
ch.ch_odile.bio2: Never left the program's orbit. Calls you her sibling.
ch.ch_odile.bio3: Can become your best ally or Containment's sharpest tool.
ch.ch_proto.name: Proto
ch.ch_proto.bio1: A prototype Porygon, running a loop of failed commands for years.
ch.ch_proto.bio2: Afraid, not hostile. It only knows how to act on instructions.
ch.ch_iris_vandermeer.name: Iris Vandermeer
ch.ch_iris_vandermeer.bio1: Clinic scientist caught between ethics and a paycheck.
ch.ch_iris_vandermeer.bio2: A decent person who flags what she sees.
ev_intro_aether.vance.v2: A white room. A window. A soft voice counting. Vance does not comment.
ev_intro_aether.vance.v3: "And is that where it starts, or where it ends?"
ev_intro_aether.b2: Marginalia is told to stop drawing.
ev_subject_zero.files.v1: The corridor smells of cold metal. The files describe a program with several subjects.
ev_subject_zero.files.v2: A last page: "Subject Zero is not to leave the facility."
ev_subject_zero.files.v3: You already know whose handwriting it is.
ev_subject_zero.b1: An abandoned research facility. Pages are redacted in neat black lines.
ev_familiar_voice.okoro.v1: "It was never meant to hurt anyone."
ev_familiar_voice.okoro.v2: "I wanted them to be friends. Humans and Pokémon. That was all."
ev_familiar_voice.okoro.v3: "There was a second page of the proposal. I never showed anyone."
ev_familiar_voice.okoro.v4: "You were a control. I am so sorry. I did not know until the end."
ev_familiar_voice.b1: Sit with me. I will tell you my version, and you may tell me where it is wrong.
ev_humanitys_question.ralts.v1: A wild Ralts approaches in a way that is almost instinctual.
ev_humanitys_question.ralts.v2: For a moment you feel what it feels. Then it passes.
ev_humanitys_question.ralts.v3: It tilts its head, the way you do.
ev_humanitys_question.b1: A wild Ralts steps out of the grass and does not stop.
ev_proto_1.proto.v1: A ruined lab. A Porygon repeats a failed command and attacks anything that moves.
ev_proto_1.proto.v2: It strikes again. The loop does not break.
ev_proto_1.proto.v3: The sound it makes is not a growl.
ev_proto_1.b1: A ruined lab. A Porygon repeats a failed command and attacks anything that moves.
ev_proto_1.b2: It strikes again. The loop does not break.
ev_proto_2.proto.v1: You notice it is afraid, not hostile.
ev_proto_2.proto.v2: It stops the instant you stop moving.
ev_proto_2.proto.v3: The loop slows by one step.
ev_proto_2.b1: You notice it is afraid, not hostile.
ev_proto_2.b2: It stops the instant you stop moving.
ev_proto_3.proto.v1: You calm it with patterns, not force.
ev_proto_3.proto.v2: It copies the rhythm of your hands.
ev_proto_3.proto.v3: The loop breaks. It does not know what to do with the silence.
ev_proto_3.b1: You calm it with patterns, not force.
ev_proto_3.b2: It copies the rhythm of your hands.
ev_proto_4.proto.v1: A choice: help it stabilize, or let Containment retrieve it.
ev_proto_4.proto.v2: The squad is a corridor away.
ev_proto_4.proto.v3: It looks at you the way it was never taught to.
ev_proto_4.b1: A choice: help it stabilize, or let Containment retrieve it.
ev_proto_4.b2: The squad is a corridor away.
ev_calibration.iris.v1: "Your readings are not in the normal range. Please, sit."
ev_calibration.iris.v2: "I will not log it. Not yet. Come back and talk to me."
ev_calibration.iris.v3: "Your numbers are better than they were. That is not nothing."
ev_calibration.b1: A clinic scanner hums. The needle does something it should not.
ev_subject_four.odile.v1: "You are Zero. You are! I am Four. We matched."
ev_subject_four.odile.v2: "I never left. Did you know? They never really made me go."
ev_subject_four.odile.v3: "You look like someone who got out. I want that too."
ev_subject_four.b1: I have been waiting for someone with my kind of quiet.
ev_audio_log_1.log.v1: A lullaby, playing from a cracked speaker in a ruined room.
ev_audio_log_1.log.v2: You know the melody. You have never heard it.
ev_audio_log_1.log.v3: Someone, once, sang it to you.
ev_audio_log_1.b1: A lullaby, playing from a cracked speaker in a ruined room.
ev_audio_log_1.b2: You know the melody. You have never heard it.
ev_audio_log_2.log.v1: An argument on tape. Two voices, one of them Okoro's.
ev_audio_log_2.log.v2: "We cannot tell her," one of them says.
ev_audio_log_2.log.v3: The tape ends in the middle of a word.
ev_audio_log_2.b1: An argument on tape. Two voices, one of them Okoro's.
ev_audio_log_2.b2: "We cannot tell her," one of them says.
ev_audio_log_3.log.v1: A goodbye, recorded in a hurry.
ev_audio_log_3.log.v2: The voice is kind. That is the worst part.
ev_audio_log_3.log.v3: You press play again. You press it again.
ev_audio_log_3.b1: A goodbye, recorded in a hurry.
ev_audio_log_3.b2: The voice is kind. That is the worst part.
ev_decommission.castellan.v1: "Come willingly and I will tell you everything. Run, and I will find you."
ev_decommission.castellan.v2: "I am not your enemy. I am the person who has to stand here."
ev_decommission.castellan.v3: "You have been walking toward this door the whole run."
ev_decommission.b1: By order of the Aether Division, Subject Zero is to be returned.
ev_captive_1.warden.v1: A clean room. A door that opens when you ask.
ev_captive_1.warden.v2: The restricted shelf holds exactly what you asked for.
ev_captive_1.warden.v3: You do not mention the second exit.
ev_captive_1.b1: A clean room. A door that opens when you ask.
ev_captive_1.b2: The restricted shelf holds exactly what you asked for.
ev_captive_2.warden.v1: The breakout is quieter than you imagined.
ev_captive_2.warden.v2: The door opens. It was never locked.
ev_captive_2.warden.v3: You walk out. No one stops you. That is worse.
ev_captive_2.b1: The breakout is quieter than you imagined.
ev_captive_2.b2: The door opens. It was never locked.
ev_chase.squad.v1: A Containment squad closes the road behind you.
ev_chase.squad.v2: The scan-pulse finds you before the footsteps do.
ev_chase.squad.v3: You are not the only one running. Someone has drawn them off.
ev_echo_aether_01.speaker.v1: A clinic receptionist looks at the screen, then at you, then back at the screen.
ev_echo_aether_01.speaker.v2: A scanner at a ferry gate chirps twice. The guard waves you through, frowning.
ev_echo_aether_01.speaker.v3: A sign: "Biometric screening in progress." You take the long way round.
ev_echo_aether_01.b1: A clinic receptionist looks at the screen, then at you, then back at the screen.
ev_echo_aether_02.speaker.v1: A postcard of a white room. On the back, in a child's hand: "Still counting."
ev_echo_aether_02.speaker.v2: A radio plays a soft voice counting backwards. You change the station.
ev_echo_aether_02.speaker.v3: A stranger hums a melody you know and cannot place.
ev_echo_aether_02.b1: A postcard of a white room. On the back, in a child's hand: "Still counting."
ev_echo_aether_03.speaker.v1: A van idles across the street, plain grey. It leaves when you look at it.
ev_echo_aether_03.speaker.v2: A flyer for a "lost property" office. The description is yours.
ev_echo_aether_03.speaker.v3: A uniform you recognize disappears around a corner. You did not imagine it.
ev_echo_aether_03.b1: A van idles across the street, plain grey. It leaves when you look at it.
ev_end_own_choice.narrator.v1: You walk out of the last facility unobserved. The registration stitch is cut.
ev_end_own_choice.b1: You walk out of the last facility unobserved. The registration stitch is cut.
ev_end_proof.narrator.v1: You use the lab's own data to show the premise was wrong. Dr. Okoro watches, speechless.
ev_end_proof.narrator.v2: The numbers are the same. The conclusion is yours.
ev_end_proof.narrator.v3: The numbers are the same. The conclusion is yours.
ev_end_proof.b1: You use the lab's own data to show the premise was wrong. Dr. Okoro watches, speechless.
ev_end_proof.b2: The numbers are the same. The conclusion is yours.
ev_end_integration.narrator.v1: You choose to work with the research on your own terms.
ev_end_integration.narrator.v2: The first rule is that you can stop.
ev_end_integration.narrator.v3: The first rule is that you can stop.
ev_end_integration.b1: You choose to work with the research on your own terms.
ev_end_integration.b2: The first rule is that you can stop.
ev_end_dissolve.narrator.v1: You disappear into the program. Odile finishes the walk alone.
ev_end_dissolve.narrator.v2: The door closes quietly behind her.
ev_end_dissolve.narrator.v3: The door closes quietly behind her.
ev_end_dissolve.b1: You disappear into the program. Odile finishes the walk alone.
ev_end_dissolve.b2: The door closes quietly behind her.
lore.lore_concordance.name: Project Concordance
lore.lore_concordance.i1: A study of whether a person could be raised with high neurological and emotional overlap with Pokémon.
lore.lore_concordance.i2: A project with several subjects, most of them redacted.
lore.lore_concordance.body: A study of whether a person could be raised with high neurological and emotional overlap with Pokémon.
lore.lore_sound_of_quiet.name: The Sound of Quiet
lore.lore_sound_of_quiet.i1: A lullaby, an argument and a goodbye. Together they say what one of them alone would not.
lore.lore_sound_of_quiet.body: A lullaby, an argument and a goodbye. Together they say what one of them alone would not.
lore.lore_vance_reviewed.name: The ethics paper
lore.lore_vance_reviewed.i1: Vance reviewed the original ethics paper and signed it, with reservations.
lore.lore_vance_reviewed.body: Vance reviewed the original ethics paper and signed it, with reservations.
lore.lore_aether_division.name: The Aether Division of the Halvard Institute
lore.lore_aether_division.i1: An original research body of the Halvard Institute. Unrelated to any foundation you might have heard of.
lore.lore_aether_division.body: An original research body of the Halvard Institute. Unrelated to any foundation you might have heard of.
bs.aether.name: Aether Experiment
ch.ch_ravenna_kuroda.name: Captain Ravenna Kuroda
ch.ch_ravenna_kuroda.bio1: Your Survey Corps mentor, seen in flashbacks. Stern and wry.
ch.ch_ravenna_kuroda.bio2: Wrote a letter to someone who never received it.
ch.ch_ravenna_kuroda.bio3: Her last orders to you were an ordinary Tuesday.
ch.ch_prosper_lund.name: Archivist Prosper Lund
ch.ch_prosper_lund.bio1: Modern archaeologist at the Cairnmoor dig. Curious, kind and a little too excited.
ch.ch_prosper_lund.bio2: Keeps a chair at the station for a visitor who has not arrived yet.
ch.ch_prosper_lund.bio3: Has read every record of the rift and has never said so aloud.
ch.ch_mara_kuroda_lund.name: Mara Kuroda-Lund
ch.ch_mara_kuroda_lund.bio1: Works at a ferry stop and looks almost exactly like Captain Kuroda. Not related.
ch.ch_mara_kuroda_lund.bio2: Becomes a recurring friend, and a choice anchor at the Return Window.
ch.ch_tin.name: Tin
ch.ch_tin.bio1: The companion Pokémon that did not cross with you. Its absence matters.
ev_intro_hisui.vance.v1: Vance does not recognize the constellations on your hand-drawn star chart.
ev_intro_hisui.vance.v2: "Where are you from?" She does not laugh.
ev_intro_hisui.vance.v3: "I think I have something you will want to see later."
ev_intro_hisui.b2: She retrieves a map case from a high shelf and sets it down, unopened.
ev_world_reborn.lund.v1: "We found it under the third layer. Do you know what it is?"
ev_world_reborn.lund.v2: You do. You used it. You do not say so yet.
ev_world_reborn.lund.v3: "You have held this before," he says, and watches your hands.
ev_world_reborn.b1: The Cairnmoor dig. A relic you once carried sits in a shallow tray under a lamp.
ev_familiar_stranger.mara.v1: "Do I know you? You are looking at me like I should."
ev_familiar_stranger.mara.v2: She tilts her head the way a captain once did.
ev_familiar_stranger.mara.v3: "I keep thinking I have met you. I have not. Have I?"
ev_familiar_stranger.b1: The ferry is ten minutes out. You can wait here if you like.
ev_old_method.observer.v1: "Stay low. Choose your style before it chooses for you."
ev_old_method.observer.v2: A flicker of a lesson from a long time ago.
ev_old_method.observer.v3: Modern trainers gather to watch. Someone is filming.
ev_old_method.b1: A large wild Alpha stands in the road. The old way is open to you.
ev_old_method.c.sneak: Sneak up and throw from behind
ev_temporal_1.distortions.v1: At the campsite a fountain runs backwards and nobody finds it odd but you.
ev_temporal_1.distortions.v2: Your shadow arrives a heartbeat after you do.
ev_temporal_1.b1: At the campsite a fountain runs backwards and nobody finds it odd but you.
ev_temporal_1.b2: Your shadow arrives a heartbeat after you do.
ev_temporal_2.records.v1: Lund spreads three centuries of records across a table.
ev_temporal_2.records.v2: "Every time the rift opened, someone was here to see it," he says.
ev_temporal_2.records.v3: He does not look up. He does not need to.
ev_temporal_2.b1: Lund spreads three centuries of records across a table.
ev_temporal_2.b2: "Every time the rift opened, someone was here to see it," he says.
ev_temporal_3.site.v1: A Hisui-style site, reconstructed. You know where everything should be.
ev_temporal_3.site.v2: A banner is hung wrong. You fix it without thinking.
ev_temporal_3.site.v3: Someone behind you says, "Thank you." You have no idea who.
ev_temporal_3.b1: A Hisui-style site, reconstructed. You know where everything should be.
ev_temporal_3.b2: A banner is hung wrong. You fix it without thinking.
ev_temporal_4.shepherd.v1: The Hollow Shepherd appears, vast and quiet.
ev_temporal_4.shepherd.v2: It does not threaten. It waits.
ev_temporal_4.shepherd.v3: The air around it remembers a different century.
ev_temporal_4.b1: The Hollow Shepherd appears, vast and quiet.
ev_temporal_4.b2: It does not threaten. It waits.
ev_temporal_5.window.v1: The Window opens: a gap in the air that smells of snow.
ev_temporal_5.window.v2: You can step through, or stay.
ev_temporal_5.window.v3: Either way, the next step is yours.
ev_temporal_5.b1: The Window opens: a gap in the air that smells of snow.
ev_temporal_5.b2: You can step through, or stay.
ev_lost_vocabulary.lund.v1: "Did you just call my phone a 'little talking stone'?"
ev_lost_vocabulary.lund.v2: You say an old word. Lund understands it. A small memory passes between you.
ev_lost_vocabulary.lund.v3: You say a modern word correctly. Lund applauds.
ev_lost_vocabulary.b1: I'm sorry, what do you mean by "hearth-glass"?
ev_old_road.kuroda.v1: A letter addressed to someone who never received it.
ev_old_road.kuroda.v2: It is in her handwriting. It begins with your name.
ev_old_road.kuroda.v3: The ball in the grass rocks gently, as if breathing.
ev_old_road.b1: Survey Corps trail markers lead to a ruined outpost, a letter, and a battered Poké Ball.
ev_museum_piece.lund.v1: "That one is on loan. Fascinating, isn't it?"
ev_museum_piece.lund.v2: You know the knots on it. You tied them.
ev_museum_piece.lund.v3: "Anything you would like to add to the label?"
ev_museum_piece.b1: A glass case. Inside is something that once belonged to you.
ev_museum_piece.c.note: Add a note to the exhibit
ev_return_window.mara.v1: "Whatever you pick, I'll be here. Or I won't. But I'll have wanted to be."
ev_return_window.mara.v2: She is wearing an indigo scarf. You are not sure when she got it.
ev_return_window.mara.v3: "It looks the same on my side," she says, and takes your hand.
ev_return_window.b1: The Window opens for exactly two Nodes. You are asked, truthfully, what you want.
ev_echo_hisui_01.speaker.v1: A child points at your boots and asks if you are in a play.
ev_echo_hisui_01.speaker.v2: A vending machine hums at you. You hum back, out of politeness.
ev_echo_hisui_01.speaker.v3: A passer-by offers to take a photo of your coat. You say no, then yes.
ev_echo_hisui_01.b1: A child points at your boots and asks if you are in a play.
ev_echo_hisui_02.speaker.v1: A bus driver nods at your satchel and says nothing. It is somehow the kindest thing.
ev_echo_hisui_02.speaker.v2: Snow begins to fall in a town that never has any. It stops after a minute.
ev_echo_hisui_02.speaker.v3: You catch yourself reaching for a compass that is no longer there.
ev_echo_hisui_02.b1: A bus driver nods at your satchel and says nothing. It is somehow the kindest thing.
ev_echo_hisui_03.speaker.v1: A wild Pokémon stops in the road, looks at you, and leaves a berry.
ev_echo_hisui_03.speaker.v2: In a shop window, you glimpse a reflection with a companion at its feet. Gone when you look.
ev_echo_hisui_03.speaker.v3: You wake to the sound of a small pair of feet that is not there.
ev_echo_hisui_03.b1: A wild Pokémon stops in the road, looks at you, and leaves a berry.
ev_end_home.narrator.v1: You say goodbye to your modern friends. The last shot is an indigo coat vanishing into snow.
ev_end_home.narrator.v2: Tin is waiting on the far side.
ev_end_home.narrator.v3: Tin is waiting on the far side.
ev_end_home.b1: You say goodbye to your modern friends. The last shot is an indigo coat vanishing into snow.
ev_end_home.b2: Tin is waiting on the far side.
ev_end_present.narrator.v1: A modern job, a new friendship and a small joke in the Dictionary.
ev_end_present.narrator.v2: You keep the satchel. You do not use it.
ev_end_present.narrator.v3: You keep the satchel. You do not use it.
ev_end_present.b1: A modern job, a new friendship and a small joke in the Dictionary.
ev_end_present.b2: You keep the satchel. You do not use it.
ev_end_bridge.narrator.v1: You become a guide between eras. At the dig site, old and new Trainers stand side by side.
ev_end_bridge.narrator.v2: Lund writes it down and, for once, says nothing.
ev_end_bridge.narrator.v3: Lund writes it down and, for once, says nothing.
ev_end_bridge.b1: You become a guide between eras. At the dig site, old and new Trainers stand side by side.
ev_end_bridge.b2: Lund writes it down and, for once, says nothing.
ev_end_lost.narrator.v1: You stand in the field where it opened. Lund quietly says there is a chair at the station for you.
ev_end_lost.narrator.v2: It is the first time the word "home" does not hurt.
ev_end_lost.narrator.v3: It is the first time the word "home" does not hurt.
ev_end_lost.b1: You stand in the field where it opened. Lund quietly says there is a chair at the station for you.
ev_end_lost.b2: It is the first time the word "home" does not hurt.

lore.lore_cairnmoor_relic.i1: A tool of the Survey Corps, found under the third layer of the dig.
lore.lore_cairnmoor_relic.body: A tool of the Survey Corps, found under the third layer of the dig.
lore.lore_dictionary.name: The Dictionary
lore.lore_dictionary.i1: Twenty-four modern words, learned the hard way.
lore.lore_dictionary.body: Twenty-four modern words, learned the hard way.
lore.lore_kuroda_letter.name: Captain Kuroda's letter
lore.lore_kuroda_letter.i1: A letter left on an outpost shelf, for someone who was sent forward in time.
lore.lore_kuroda_letter.body: A letter left on an outpost shelf, for someone who was sent forward in time.
lore.lore_temporal_disturbance.name: The Temporal Disturbance
lore.lore_temporal_disturbance.i1: A rift tied to an ancient Legendary, the Hollow Shepherd.
lore.lore_temporal_disturbance.i2: A wound in the year, healing slowly and in the wrong order.
lore.lore_temporal_disturbance.body: A rift tied to an ancient Legendary, the Hollow Shepherd.
